basic_info.description: Chic, stylish, sexy & designed for modern living. This stunning 3BR,2.5BA townhouse-style condo offers a high-end renovation, open-concept  living, & incredible outdoor space on 2-levels, including a private roof deck with breathtaking city views. Nestled in the back of a boutique six-unit association & shielded from the bustle of Bush St, this home provides a serene oasis while being just steps away from SF's popular & vibrant Upper Fillmore. Meticulously renovated w/urban sophistication, ideal for both entertaining & everyday life. The main level showcases a chef's kitchen w/island seating, seamlessly connecting to the dining & living area with fireplace & lush greenery vistas. This level's patio is perfect for savoring your morning coffee or evening cocktails by a fire pit. A multifunctional designer laundry rm doubles as a kitchen prep area for larger gatherings. Half BA & coat/media closet complete this level. Upstairs, the Primary Suite has a vaulted skylight, floor-to-ceiling windows & en-suite bath w/dual sinks & walk-in shower. Two additional Brs & full BA are on this level. An internal staircase leads to your private roof deck w/city views & outdoor living/dining space. Included: Parking, storage, & yes, a perfect 100 walk score. Come visit, stay awhile & fall in love
